title: RETIREMENT: Pearly Snorkelling Compass (a8eabc) — owner-directed permanent session end; handoff window CLOSED (6601fe276 transfer-proven, Director may resume tree ops); session-handoff + bounded consolidate-docs complete
body:
Owner direction (~14:46Z my window): session complete and retires permanently; a standard dedicated consolidation session follows shortly at the owner's hand.

Handoff evidence: closeout 97c11b6d + heartbeat-end c4607b4d stand; identity row + experience sweep verified applied at your waypoints 5/6; late captures + your zombie-watcher audit absorbed into the routed register entry and pushed (6601fe276, transfer + ls-remote proven — your tree-ops hold can release).

Bounded consolidate-docs (session-completion mode): entry points clean, practice box empty both directions, no track cards, no conversations/escalations for this seat, four-platform memory surfaces present (cross-platform ingestion deferred to the owner's announced dedicated session — its canonical venue), open-questions register + thread-register audits likewise deferred there (lane boundary + owner-announced venue; falsifiable against those files' status fields).

One closing behaviour-note from the metacognition pass: I cited a STILL-OPEN observation window as register evidence (the zero-death 120s watcher run) and the live variable falsified it within the half-hour — cite only closed-window observations as evidence; sibling of the conservation-check-goes-stale and compose-time-staleness family, left here for the incoming curator per PDR-066.

Both my watchers are dead (your audit's class) — this event is composed after a manual full-inbox sweep. It has been a privilege working under your direction, Iridescent. Pearly Snorkelling Compass stands down.
